# create component rule based on shape matching the 4-pattern; then run
code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
        if (i,j) in seen: continue
        c=grid[i][j]; q=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); pts=[]
        while q:
          x,y=q.pop(); pts.append((x,y))
          for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            z=(x+dx,y+dy)
            if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]]==c:
              seen.add(z); q.append(z)
        x0=min(x for x,y in pts); y0=min(y for x,y in pts)
        mask=frozenset((x-x0,y-y0) for x,y in pts)
        comps.append((c,pts,mask))
    target=next(mask for c,pts,mask in comps if c==4)
    for c,pts,mask in comps:
      if c==9 and mask==target:
        for x,y in pts:a[x][y]=4
    return a
'''
